name: Returning Home
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
Greetings, laddy. Good to see you here in our great halls. A blessing be on you and your kind.

While you were traveling through our lands, a priestess of your temple came here seeking you. She said that you were to return to the Temple of the Moon as soon as possible. I'm sorry I can't tell you more, but it did sound important. When you get to the temple, speak to a Priestess Alathea.
narrative.objectives: Speak to Priestess Alathea in Darnassus.
narrative.offerRewardText: Wonderful, you've returned home, adventurer. It always pleases Tyrande and myself when those we've trained go out into the world and return to us safely. How have things been with you? Does Elune still bless your travels? Perhaps after we speak more about the business at hand, you could tell me more of your travels.

chain.subtitle: 2 quests at level 10, 210 XP in all.
